notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other Foods
description:
Activate Savvy Hunter by sacrificing two Foods.
Experimental Confectioner's second ability and Ygra trigger twice.
Resolve both Experimental Confectioner triggers, creating two 1/1 Rat  creature tokens that are Foods due to Ygra.
Resolve both Ygra triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Savvy Hunter ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
